posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Hey, folks!

I'm getting ready to leave town for a few days, but I wanted to let you know: there's not an Interlude coming this Thursday. There was supposed to be! We recorded one, and it was really great! However, the files got corrupted in the saving process, and we're unable to recover them. I just recorded a quick note that will go at the start of the NightMist episode about it, and we'll re-record the story Interlude stuff and post that in the next couple weeks. But, I wanted to let you know that the promised Interlude is NOT coming this Thursday, but it will come later.

Sorry about that! I'm glad we made it this far without technical issues, and I hope this is the worst thing that happens to The Letters Page this year!

posts.cooked:
Not so easily done when I'm not here to make that happen. It's just a perfect storm of unfortunate coincidences.

Also, oddly, the interludes get WAY less listeners than the regular episodes. Hundreds fewer. I have no idea why this is. 

Hero episodes get the most listeners. Villain episodes get notably fewer, but still lots. Interludes get far, far fewer.

All of that really surprises me. I rarely listen to podcasts, but when I do, I don't just randomly skip episodes. Even if they're shorter.
